---
name: review
description: Review changes against the product requirements and project conventions.
---

Review the current changes against `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
Find concrete defects first: incorrect data mapping, duplicate score increments, repeated threshold triggers, incorrect theme variant, cart-state mismatch, accessibility issues, and regressions.
Provide severity, file/line reference, impact, and a concise fix. Separate confirmed issues from unverified risks. Do not make edits.
